caption:
Not every lead deserves the same response speed.

A referral from a happy customer forgives a personal callback tomorrow. A stranger who clicked a search ad won't forgive an hour of silence.

Sort incoming leads into three tiers by source: relationship, active-intent, and interrupted-attention. Give each tier its own response rule instead of one five-minute scramble for everyone.

Want it built into your CRM?
DM SCALE

#ServiceBusiness #LeadGeneration #CRMAutomation #HomeServiceMarketing #SmallBusinessGrowth
rationale: Carousels still win saves/depth for B2B authority content, and a source-based lead-tiering framework is a genuinely unclaimed mental model distinct from every stage, ladder, decay-curve, objection, and tiering framework shipped to date.
